notes.title: "Your Wife Oh" will be officially released on October 25!
notes.content:
[b]"Your Wife Oh" will be officially released on October 25![/b]

< Your Wife Oh >< Sports Girl: Village >< Rescue Girl Operation > These three games will be released on October 25, at the same time as the launch of the bundle. The bundle will offer a 15% discount. Players who like all three games. You can buy them at the same time! It's very cost effective.
